import os, re
from openpyxl import load_workbook

input_path = '/mnt/data/spreadsheet/51958/1_51958_input.xlsx'
output_path = '/mnt/data/outputs/51958_0_9b377d66/1_51958_output.xlsx'

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb['Sheet1']

raw = ws['A2'].value  # e.g. "9th Aug 10:06"
s = str(raw).strip()

# Parse day with ordinal suffix, month abbreviation/name, and time
m = re.match(r"^\s*(\d{1,2})(?:st|nd|rd|th)?\s+([A-Za-z]+)\s+(\d{1,2}:\d{2})\s*$", s)
if not m:
    raise ValueError(f"Unrecognized date/time format: {s!r}")

day = int(m.group(1))
mon_text = m.group(2).lower()[:3]
time_text = m.group(3)

months = {
    'jan': 1, 'feb': 2, 'mar': 3, 'apr': 4, 'may': 5, 'jun': 6,
    'jul': 7, 'aug': 8, 'sep': 9, 'oct': 10, 'nov': 11, 'dec': 12
}
month = months[mon_text]

# The requested standardized example uses year 21.
standardized = f"{day:02d}/{month:02d}/21 {time_text}"

# Cell-Level Manipulation: write ONLY to B2.
ws['B2'] = standardized

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)

print("Wrote", output_path, "B2=", ws['B2'].value)
